groups.name: spring.setting.mongodb
groups.description: Configuration properties for Spring Setting MongoDB module using reactive MongoDB operations.

groups.name: spring.setting.audit
groups.description: Audit log feature for the Spring Setting admin API. Requires spring-setting-admin on the classpath and spring.setting.audit.enabled=true to activate.

groups.name: spring.setting.audit.mongodb
groups.description: MongoDB-specific configuration for the audit log persistence.

properties.name: spring.setting.mongodb.collection-name
properties.description: Name of the MongoDB collection to store settings. Defaults to 'settings'.

properties.name: spring.setting.audit.enabled
properties.description: Enables the audit log. When true, every PATCH, PUT, and DELETE is recorded with the previous value, new value, caller identity, and timestamp. History and revert endpoints become available. Requires spring-setting-admin on the classpath.

properties.name: spring.setting.audit.mongodb.collection-name
properties.description: Name of the MongoDB collection used to store audit log entries.

properties.name: spring.setting.audit.mongodb.max-entries-per-type
properties.description: Maximum number of audit entries retained per setting type. After each write the oldest entries exceeding this limit are evicted. Set to 0 or a negative value to disable eviction entirely.

values.description: Default collection — one document per audit event.
Convention used when multiple services share the same MongoDB instance.
